pageOne.title: Make your app look as good as it works.
pageOne.description: Mobi is a free, open-source editor for creating App Store and Google Play screenshots.

pageTwo.title: Making screenshots shouldn't be harder than making the app.
pageTwo.description: General-purpose design tools can be overwhelming when all you need is a great-looking store listing. And many dedicated screenshot tools put their best features behind a subscription.

pageThree.title: Mobi is free and open-source.
pageThree.description: Mobi is built by indie developers for indie developers.

editor.title: Editor
editor.description: Use the editor to create and modify your content.
